message.content:
This is a modern, minimalist login page with a warm, dark brown gradient background that transitions from deep brown at the edges to a slightly lighter amber-brown in the center, creating a subtle vignette effect. The entire page has a clean, centered layout with all elements aligned vertically in the middle of the screen.

**Header Section:**
At the top, there's a "Back to Home" link in a warm orange color with a left-facing arrow icon, positioned slightly above the center. Below this, the brand logo appears - a square orange icon with a white lightning bolt symbol inside, followed by the brand name "PARWA" in bold, white, uppercase letters. The logo is centered and serves as a focal point.

**Main Content:**
The main content area is contained within a semi-transparent dark brown card with rounded corners and a subtle shadow, creating a floating effect against the background. The card has a slight opacity, allowing the gradient background to show through.

Inside the card:
- A large, bold white heading "Welcome back" is centered at the top of the card
- Below it, a smaller gray text reads "Sign in to your account to continue"

**Form Elements:**
The login form contains several elements arranged vertically:
- A "Continue with Google" button with a white Google "G" icon on the left, gray background, and white text
- A thin divider line with the text "or continue with email" in gray, centered
- An email address field with a light brown background, orange envelope icon on the left, and placeholder text "you@example.com" in gray
- A password field with a light brown background, orange lock icon on the left, and placeholder text "Enter your password" in gray. This field has an eye icon on the right for showing/hiding the password
- A "Forgot password?" link in orange, positioned to the right of the password field label
- A prominent orange "Sign in" button with white text, spanning the full width of the form
- At the bottom, a text link "Don't have an account? Sign up" with "Sign up" in orange and the rest in gray

**Footer:**
Below the card, centered at the bottom of the page, is a "Need help? Contact Support" link in gray, with "Contact Support" in orange.

**Additional Elements:**
In the bottom left corner, there's a small black circular button with a white "N" inside, likely a notification or help button.

The color scheme is dominated by warm browns and oranges, creating a cohesive and professional appearance. The design uses plenty of white space and clear visual hierarchy to guide the user through the login process.
